answer: Park a unique identity token on a public knoll that only one bonded key may occupy. The token is an ivory chit, issued at a crowded wharf after a large deposit is locked, and it cannot be copied or transferred. Peers refuse work from any address that lacks its own chit or that tries to share one. A sybil farm must therefore buy and defend a separate chit for every name, which turns cheap cloning into a capital problem.
